healthy_qualification.reference: Independent explicit affine inventories and bounded instrument noise, not the runtime generator's state

regressions: Pump debounce counts relevant fresh samples; unrelated updates cannot create a streak
Missing coverage breaks streaks and clears the integration window, not active incidents
Opposing per-channel transitions cannot cancel their quadrature bounds
Native pump loss and residual/recovery use explicit analytical onset checks
initial_failures: Qualification test initially lacked the engine declaration include; corrected before execution
The first ASan adapter run delayed capture/manual commands while reparsing unchanged heartbeats; deduplicated sample/quality signatures, then all affected checks passed
self_review: Checked clock domains, temporal assumptions, source/context retirement, sensor-specific debounce, resource bounds, witness reconstruction, acknowledgement and absence of model/actuator work per packet. This is not a formal owner review.
limitations: Synthetic local evidence. Durable event retention, observed forecasts, offline EWMA/CUSUM comparison and broader fault qualification remain subsequent work.
